caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil or a similar gray medium on an off-white or slightly yellowed paper. It depicts a detailed corner section of an ornate textile or decorative panel, viewed from above. The design is composed of several borders and fills, arranged in nested rectangles. The outermost border has a pattern of grapevine motifs, with clusters of small rounded berries and pointed leaves attached to winding, curving stems. Inside this, a narrow border with a repeating twisted ribbon or rope pattern separates the grapevine area from the next section. The next border is filled with a tightly repeated diamond or lattice pattern, creating a textured look. This is followed by another narrow border featuring the same twisted ribbon motif. The innermost large section contains a partially visible circular medallion with a scalloped edge and radiating lines, surrounded by swirling vines, leaves, and small floral elements which echo the organic forms of the outer grapevine border. The drawing focuses on careful line work and patterning, highlighting the intricate, ornamental nature of the design. No objects apart from these decorative motifs can be observed.
title: White Quilted Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
